name: copycolors_mcqa
description:
This dataset consists of formatted n-way multiple choice questions, where n is in [2,10]. The task itself is simply to copy the prototypical color from the context and produce the corresponding color's answer choice letter.
The "prototypical colors" dataset instances themselves come from Memory Colors (Norland et al. 2021) and corypaik/coda (instances whose object_group is 0, indicating participants agreed on a prototypical color of that object).
reputation: Small, focused probing dataset (part of MIB-bench) used for testing models' memory/prototypical color knowledge; limited but useful for narrow evaluations.
